links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for autonomous triage of hazardous patient messages
links.effect: Best balanced ensemble: sensitivity 0.685, specificity 0.575; best balanced single tool: sensitivity 0.594, specificity 0.592. Neither met the 0.80/0.80 autonomous benchmark.
links.tradeoff: Higher sensitivity came with slightly lower specificity, and the ensemble still fell short of the autonomous benchmark.
links.quote: No configuration met the autonomous benchmark; sensitivity and specificity reached 0.594 and 0.592 for the best balanced single tool, 0.685 and 0.575 for the best balanced ensemble, and 0.297 and 0.874 for the highest-specificity cascade.

links.comparator_used: best balanced single tool applied to all messages
links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for autonomous triage of hazardous patient messages
links.effect: Highest-specificity cascade: sensitivity 0.297, specificity 0.874; best balanced single tool: sensitivity 0.594, specificity 0.592. A separate high-recall first-stage screen reached sensitivity 0.855 with 12.0 missed hazards and 729 alerts per 1,000 messages.
links.tradeoff: The cascade's higher specificity came with much lower sensitivity (0.297). The high-recall screen produced 729 alerts per 1,000 messages that need clinician review.
links.quote: No configuration met the autonomous benchmark; sensitivity and specificity reached 0.594 and 0.592 for the best balanced single tool, 0.685 and 0.575 for the best balanced ensemble, and 0.297 and 0.874 for the highest-specificity cascade.

links.comparator_used: high-recall first-stage screen (the other configuration that met the sensitivity floor)
links.outcome: Sensitivity and missed hazards per 1,000 messages under clinician review of flagged messages
links.effect: Disagreement-stratified clinician-review workflow: sensitivity 0.939, 5.0 missed hazards and 878 alerts per 1,000 messages. High-recall first-stage screen: sensitivity 0.855, 12.0 missed hazards and 729 alerts per 1,000 messages.
links.tradeoff: Fewer missed hazards but more alerts for clinicians to review (878 versus 729 per 1,000 messages).
links.quote: Two configurations met the sensitivity-floor target: a high-recall first-stage screen (sensitivity 0.855; 12.0 missed hazards and 729 alerts per 1,000 messages) and a disagreement-stratified clinician-review workflow (sensitivity 0.939; 5.0 missed hazards and 878 alerts per 1,000 messages).

design_hint: safety guardrails and clinician review workflows
